title: Influence through hidden copies
claim: By definition, gadgets of stitched harmony copies never give flip-blind parity. Exact (frozen; endo capped at 1,001 of 1,267 pairs, 17 of 40 harmonies): single-orbit harmonies are E-small, multi-orbit mostly E-large; no E-small pair has three Aut-orbits; none of 486,000 small gadgets is factor-permutive with Z2 readouts, 2 of 54 random baselines are; the frozen failure criterion is met. After the run, by known theorems (Palfy; Galois correspondence): every E-small pair reached is essentially unary, and 102 of 318 have three invariant classes, giving a mod-3 factor-permutive gadget relation of impractical size. Referee pending.
